name: Sargeras
summary: Sargeras is the fallen titan and supreme creator of the Burning Legion, bent on scouring all life from the cosmos. Once the noble champion and defender of the Pantheon, his descent into madness led to the Sundering of ancient Azeroth and nearly every demonic catastrophe since.

sections.title: Champion of the Pantheon
sections.body: Before his fall, Sargeras was the greatest and noblest warrior among the titans. Entrusted by the Pantheon of Order to safeguard their grand creations across the Great Dark Beyond, he waged war against the chaotic demons spawned from the Twisting Nether. Incapable of conceiving pure evil, Sargeras trapped countless fiends away within a great prison. Yet eons of relentless warfare against cosmic horrors gradually wore down his altruistic spirit.

sections.title: Despair and the Burning Crusade
sections.body: Over eons of battle, Sargeras's faith in the titans' work eroded. Despairing at the evil he faced, he concluded that creation was fundamentally flawed and that order could never truly prevail. Turning his back on the Pantheon, he shattered the demons' prison, embraced the chaotic fel fire he had once fought, and marshaled the liberated demons into the unstoppable Burning Legion.

sections.title: Obsession with Azeroth
sections.body: Ten thousand years ago, the reckless magic of Queen Azshara and her Highborne reached across the stars, alerting Sargeras to Azeroth's existence. Whispering through the depths of the Well of Eternity, the Dark Titan seduced Azshara into opening a portal for his vanguard. Though that ancient invasion culminated in the catastrophic Sundering, Sargeras never ceased scheming to consume Azeroth—orchestrating the opening of the Dark Portal and guiding the demonic corruption of the orcish Horde.

faq.answer: Sargeras is a fallen titan who once served as the Pantheon's greatest warrior. Driven by despair over cosmic corruption, he betrayed his kind and forged the Burning Legion to purge all life from the universe.

faq.q: Why does Sargeras want to destroy the universe?
aliases: why does sargeras want to destroy everything
faq.answer: Eons of battling demons and corruption drove him to despair. He came to believe that creation itself was flawed and that order could never prevail, and chose to burn away all life rather than let it go on.

faq.q: What is Sargeras's connection to Queen Azshara?
faq.answer: Ten thousand years ago, Queen Azshara's reckless use of the Well of Eternity drew Sargeras's attention. Viewing him as a god, Azshara and her Highborne attempted to summon the Dark Titan through the Well, triggering the devastating War of the Ancients and the Great Sundering.

aliases: where did the burning legion come from
faq.answer: No. Demons originally spawned naturally within the chaotic Twisting Nether. Sargeras fought and imprisoned them for ages before choosing to shatter their prison, uniting the demonic races under his command to form the Burning Legion.

faq.q: What happened to the other titans?
faq.answer: Mortal scholars do not know. The titans departed Azeroth long ago after shaping it, and nothing is known on Azeroth of what became of them after Sargeras turned against his kin.

faq.q: How was Sargeras connected to the opening of the Dark Portal?
faq.answer: Long after the Sundering, Sargeras continued his designs on Azeroth from afar, orchestrating events to corrupt the orcs of Draenor and using the guardian Medivh to tear open the Dark Portal, bringing invasion once again to mortal shores.

angles.text: For the kaldorei, Sargeras is the ultimate architect of the Great Sundering, whose seductive whispers corrupted Queen Azshara and shattered ancient Kalimdor ten millennia ago.
Warlocks draw upon the very fel powers and demon servitors bound together by the Dark Titan, wielding the ruinous sorceries that formed the Legion.
The tragic history of the orcish clans—blood-curse, madness, and the invasion of Azeroth—traces directly back to the manipulations of Sargeras and his demonic lieutenants.
Mages remember Sargeras as a cautionary terror, proving that unchecked arcane ambition will inevitably attract the gaze of the Burning Legion across the stars.
